description: Production-ready Tier 2 fine-grained route drilldown dashboard for e-commerce microservices (ecommerce-ui, product-catalog, product-inventory, order-management, shipping-and-handling, contact-support-team, mock services). Automatically displays and filters API endpoints, latency percentiles, error dynamics, concurrency saturation, and downstream cascades upon selecting a service.

panels.title: Service API Contracts & Route Registry

panels.description: Live active endpoints discovered for the selected service ($service) displaying HTTP Method, Route URI, Ingress RPS, P95 Latency, and 5xx Error Rate %.

targets.expr: sum by (path) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service"}[5m])) or sum by (path) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service"}[5m]), "path", "$1", "endpoint", "(.*)"))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, path) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[5m])) or sum by (le, path) (label_replace(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[5m]), "path", "$1", "endpoint", "(.*)")))

((sum by (path) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) or sum by (path) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", status_code=~"5.."}[5m]), "path", "$1", "endpoint", "(.*)"))) / (sum by (path) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service"}[5m])) or sum by (path) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service"}[5m]), "path", "$1", "endpoint", "(.*)")))) * 100

panels.title: Discovered Live Endpoints for $service
Quick KPI Summary & Instant Route Health ($service)

panels.description: Total incoming request rate (Throughput) for selected service and route(s).

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service"}[2m]))

panels.title: Selected Route RPS

panels.description: 95th percentile response latency for the selected service and route(s). Target: <= 250ms.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

panels.title: P95 Route Latency

panels.description: 99th percentile tail response latency for the selected service and route(s). Critical threshold: > 1.0s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

panels.title: P99 Tail Latency

panels.description: 5xx Server Error rate percentage on filtered routes. Warning: > 0.1%, Critical: > 1.0%.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", status_code=~"5.*|5.."}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method", status_code=~"5.*|5.."}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method", status=~"5.*|5.."}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", status_code=~"5.*|5.."}[2m])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service"}[2m])))) * 100

panels.title: 5xx Error Rate (%)

panels.description: Total simultaneous active in-flight requests / active HTTP server sockets currently being processed for $service.

targets.expr: sum(http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service"}) or sum(http_server_requests_active_seconds_count{job=~"$service"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active In-Flight Sockets

panels.description: Granular endpoint matrix tracking route throughput, 5xx server error rate %, P50 median latency, P95 tail latency, P99 SLA latency, and active in-flight concurrency.

targets.expr: sum by (route, method) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route!=""}[2m])) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)"))

((sum by (route, method) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route!="", status_code=~"5.*|5.."}[2m])) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path!="", status_code=~"5.*|5.."}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri!="", status=~"5.*|5.."}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)"), "status_code", "$1", "status", "(.*)"))) / (sum by (route, method) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route!=""}[2m])) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)")))) * 100

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, route, method) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le, route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (le, route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)")))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route, method) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le, route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (le, route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)")))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route, method) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le, route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (le, route, method) (label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)")))

sum by (route, method) (http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service", route!=""}) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service", path!=""}, "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route, method) (label_replace(http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service", uri!=""}, "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Top Degraded Routes Under Load ($service)

panels.description: Horizontal Bar Gauge showing load concentration across the top 10 busiest endpoints for $service.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route!=""}[2m])) or sum by (route) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route) (label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri!=""}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Throughput Distribution (Top Endpoints)

panels.description: Aggregate distribution of HTTP response code families across filtered routes for $service.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", status_code=~"2..|2.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", status_code=~"2..|2.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", status=~"2..|2.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", status_code=~"2..|2.*"}[2m]))

sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", status_code=~"3..|3.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", status_code=~"3..|3.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", status=~"3..|3.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", status_code=~"3..|3.*"}[2m]))

sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", status_code=~"4..|4.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", status_code=~"4..|4.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", status=~"4..|4.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", status_code=~"4..|4.*"}[2m]))

sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5..|5.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", status_code=~"5..|5.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", status=~"5..|5.*"}[2m])) or sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", status_code=~"5..|5.*"}[2m]))

panels.title: HTTP Status Code Ratio
Row 2: Deep Latency Profiling & Micro-SLA Breakdown

panels.description: Reveals bi-modal latency distributions, queue wait times, thread starvation, and garbage collection pauses that percentiles smooth out.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", route!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m]))

panels.title: Latency Heatmap (Concurrency & Thread Stalls)

panels.description: Detailed latency percentile spread across P50 (median baseline), P90 & P95 (tail latency), and P99 (critical worst-case user experience with 1.0s threshold line).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", path!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", path!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", path!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", path!=""}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

panels.title: Latency Percentile Spread (P50, P90, P95, P99)

panels.description: Compares Mean (average) latency against Median (P50) and P99 tail. A widening gap between Mean and P50 indicates extreme outlier latency skew dragging down system stability.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m]))) or (sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m]))) or (sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m]))) or (sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service"}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[2m])) or sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service"}[2m])))

panels.title: Mean vs Median vs P99 Tail Latency Skew

panels.description: Tracks active worker thread and socket saturation per route. Spikes without an increase in incoming RPS indicate downstream locking, database pool exhaustion, or deadlocks.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", path!=""}) or sum by (route) (label_replace(http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service", path=~"$route"}, "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route) (label_replace(http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route"}, "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)")) or sum by (job) (http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$service"})

panels.title: In-Flight Concurrency per Route

panels.description: Tracks requests cancelled by upstream proxies/clients due to client timeouts while the server is still processing under heavy load (HTTP 499 / 408).

targets.expr: sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", path!="", status_code=~"499|408"}[2m])) or sum by (route) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", status_code=~"499|408"}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route) (label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", status=~"499|408"}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Client Aborts & Drops (499 / Broken Pipes)

panels.description: Calculates P95 response payload byte sizes. Detects oversized payload responses that saturate node egress network bandwidth across microservices.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_response_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", path!=""}[2m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (label_replace(rate(http_response_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", path=~"$route"}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)"))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (label_replace(rate(http_server_response_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route"}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)"))) or (rate(http_response_bytes_total{job=~"$service"}[2m]) / rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service"}[2m]))

panels.title: Payload Size Distribution (Egress Bandwidth Bottlenecks)
Row 4: Error Decomposition & Upstream / Downstream Cascades

panels.description: Stacked distribution comparing 4xx client errors (e.g. bad input, auth failure) vs 5xx server errors (internal system degradation) across routes.

targets.expr: sum by (route, status_code) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", status_code=~"[45].."}[2m])) or sum by (route, status_code) (label_replace(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", path=~"$route", status_code=~"[45].."}[2m]), "route", "$1", "path", "(.*)")) or sum by (route, status_code) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$service", uri=~"$route", status=~"[45].."}[2m]), "route", "$1", "uri", "(.*)"), "status_code", "$1", "status", "(.*)")) or vector(0)

panels.title: Error Breakdown by Route & HTTP Status

panels.description: Tracks operational exceptions, unhandled runtime crashes, and service exception counters across microservices by exception type.

targets.expr: sum by (exception, route) (rate(http_server_exceptions_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route"}[2m])) or sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$service", route=~"$route", status_code=~"500"}[2m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Service Exceptions and Unhandled Failures

panels.description: Identifies which downstream service or upstream microservice target is initiating cascading failures when the UI gateway or orchestrator is under load.

targets.expr: sum by (target_service) (rate(downstream_service_errors_total[2m])) or sum by (target_service) (rate(downstream_service_requests_errors_total[2m])) or sum by (target_service) (label_replace(rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{status=~"5.."}[2m]), "target_service", "$1", "client_name", "(.*)")) or sum by (target_service) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"ecommerce-ui|gateway.*", target_service!="", status_code=~"5.."}[2m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Gateway Downstream Dependency Cascades

title: Tier 2: Fine-Grained Route Drilldown
